text: All verified. The fix is a one-line change: the cycle detection now compares the result length against `len(deps)` (the full node set, including dependency-only nodes) instead of `len(graph)` (only the keys). Previously, when the graph had more nodes than keys, a cycle could leave out nodes while the result still had at least as many entries as keys, so the check passed silently.
